text: Working with APIs is an important skill for modern developers. An API allows two programs to communicate with each other. Usually, your application sends an HTTP request to a server, and the server sends back data, often in JSON format. Before you can use many APIs, you need authentication, such as an API key or a token. You should also respect rate limits, which control how many requests you can make in a certain time. Finally, good error handling is essential, because requests can fail for many reasons. By checking error messages carefully, you can fix problems quickly and build more reliable applications.
